instrumentation.method: Capture the shared imported WebAssembly.Memory through Emscripten's instantiateWasm hook and report its final buffer.byteLength.
instrumentation.high_water_rationale: WebAssembly.Memory grows monotonically and does not shrink, so final linear-memory byteLength is the per-Worker high-water allocation.
instrumentation.scope: Wasm linear-memory allocation only; this is not browser-process or operating-system resident memory.

index.wasm_peak_display_note: The product UI displays 1.04 GB using binary 1024-based scaling (1.04 GiB).
index.comparison_with_2026_08_18: The earlier build was 141752090 bytes (768 bytes larger) while graph-contig and k-mer counts were identical; representative index byte-for-byte determinism is not claimed.

quant.wasm_peak_display_note: The product UI uses binary 1024-based units but currently labels the unit MB. The unrounded value is written into the generated browser_performance.json; the in-app validation browser did not persist that download externally, so this frozen report records the observed rounded value without inventing an exact byte count.
